method: Provider token-meter dollar equivalents: total_nano_aiu / 1e11 (1 AI credit = $0.01) for every usage event, from the campaign usage.jsonl ledgers (model_usage records) united with each campaign's own session-store.db, deduplicated by (session_id, usage_event_id). Cache reads/writes are inside input tokens and reasoning inside output tokens. Calls whose records carry no token detail are not priced, so totals are lower bounds. These are metered amounts, not reconciled invoices.
